question: The same printer-driver workaround has now been explained verbally by three different agents to three different callers this month, with no record kept anywhere. What is the best long-term fix, and why is it better than continuing to resolve each incident individually?

choices.text: Nothing needs to change — resolving each incident individually already documents the fix in that incident's resolution notes
Create a Knowledge Article documenting the workaround, and link it from the incidents so future agents (and self-service users) can find it without re-solving the problem each time
Convert every future occurrence into a Problem record instead of an incident
Create a new Catalog Item so users can request the fix themselves as a service request

explanation: A Knowledge Article makes a workaround reusable and searchable — by other agents and often directly by end users via self-service — which is exactly the gap when the same fix is repeatedly explained ad hoc instead of documented once.
pieges: Believing per-incident resolution notes are an adequate substitute for a searchable, reusable Knowledge Article.
Reaching for a Catalog Item, which is for requesting something, not for solving a recurring known issue.
